director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj hum dekhenge ki alag numbers wale fraction bhi barabar ho sakte hain. Toh shuru karte hain?
pata nahi

Achha, pehle main dikhati hoon. Roti aadhi modi, ek aadhe par ghee lagaya. Kaagaz ki patti par yahi: beech se modi, toh 2 barabar hisse; rang wala hissa patti ka 1/2 hai. Doosri patti bilkul utni hi lambi hai, par 10 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Pehli patti ka rang wala aadha, doosri patti ke kitne hisson jitna hai?
director.card: Doosri patti bilkul utni hi lambi hai, par 10 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Pehli patti ka rang wala aadha, doosri patti ke kitne hisson jitna hai?

Pehli patti ke rang wale hisse ke theek neeche dekho, aur doosri patti ke jo hisse wahan tak aate hain, unhe gino. Pehli patti ka rang wala aadha, 10 hisson wali doosri patti ke kitne hisson jitna hai?
director.card: Doosri patti bilkul utni hi lambi hai, par 10 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Pehli patti ka rang wala aadha, doosri patti ke kitne hisson jitna hai?

Achha, ab Hindi mein bolti hoon. Ek roti do bachche barabar baantein, toh har ek ko aadhi roti milti hai. Is patti ka rang wala hissa bhi waisa hi hai: do barabar mein se ek. 10 chhote hisson wali patti mein, aadhi patti kitne hisson ki hogi?
director.card: 10 chhote hisson wali patti mein, aadhi patti kitne hisson ki hogi?

seams.form: Achha, ab Hindi mein bolti hoon.

director.text: five

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 10 hisson ka aadha 5 hisse hai. Ab wahi patti ek baar aur modi, toh 4 barabar hisse bane. Rang wala aadha ab 2 hisson mein hai, yaani 2/4; rang utna hi raha, isliye 1/2 = 2/4. Nayi patti utni hi lambi hai, par 12 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Ismein kitne hisson mein rang bharen ki rang pehli patti jitna hi ho?
director.card: Nayi patti utni hi lambi hai, par 12 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Ismein kitne hisson mein rang bharen ki rang pehli patti jitna hi ho?

Pehle dekho ki pehli patti ke ek hisse jitni jagah mein nayi patti ke kitne hisse aate hain. Phir rang wale dono hisson jitni jagah mein gino. 12 hisson wali patti mein kitne hisson mein rang bharen ki rang pehli patti jitna ho?
director.card: Nayi patti utni hi lambi hai, par 12 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Ismein kitne hisson mein rang bharen ki rang pehli patti jitna hi ho?

director.text: 6 hisson mein

Sahi jawab. 4 × 3 = 12, toh rang wale 2 × 3 = 6. Yeh number line 0 se 1 tak 8 barabar gap mein kati hai. Beech ka mark 4/8 hai, aur wahi 1/2 bhi hai aur 2/4 bhi. Toh 1/2 = 2/4 = 4/8: ek jagah, teen naam. Isi line par 0 se chalkar 3/4 tak pahunchna hai. 1/8 wale kitne gap chalne honge?
director.card: Isi line par 0 se chalkar 3/4 tak pahunchna hai. 1/8 wale kitne gap chalne honge?

director.text: chhe

Haan, sahi hai: line par har 1/4 mein 1/8 wale 2 gap hain, toh 3/4 tak 3 × 2 = 6 gap, yaani 6/8. Aao, yeh sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge. Sana ek rumal ko aadha modti hai aur ek aadhe mein rang bharti hai. Phir use do baar aur aadha modti hai. Teeno mod ke baad rumal kholo, toh kul kitne barabar hisse dikhenge?

seams.form: Aao, yeh sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge.

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Yeh rumal pehle mod ke baad do barabar hisson mein hai, aur doosre mod ke baad chaar mein. Ek rumal ko teen baar, har baar aadha moda; kholne par kul kitne barabar hisse dikhenge?
pata nahi
Kaagaz ko ek baar modkar kholo, aur dekho ki pehle ka ek hissa ab kitne hisson mein bata hai. Ab tum batao.
haan
Ab phir se socho, jawab kya hoga?

Har mod par har hissa do mein bant-ta hai, isliye hisse har baar dugne hote hain, aur teen mod ke baad 8 ho jaate hain. Rumal ke 8 barabar hisse hain, toh har chhota hissa poore rumal ka 1/8 hai. Kholne par 8 hisson mein se kitne hisson mein rang dikhega?
director.card: Kholne par 8 hisson mein se kitne hisson mein rang dikhega?

director.text: mujhe nahi pata
Pehle mod ke baad rang ek aadhe mein tha. Agle do mod ne us rang wale aadhe ko bhi kaata; socho woh kitne hisson mein bata. Apna jawab tum khud bolo.

director.text: barabar

Sahi jawab, kyunki 6 barabar hisson mein se 3 hisse 3/6 hain, aur 3/6 = 1/2, isliye dono ne barabar khaya. Yeh number line 0 se 1 tak 12 barabar gap mein kati hai. Is line par 5/12, 1/2 se bada hai, chhota hai, ya barabar?

Haan, sahi hai. 5/12 is line par paanchve mark par hai, aur 1/2 = 6/12 chhatthe mark par, isliye 5/12 chhota hai. Modne par 1/2 se 2/4 bana: kul hisse aur rang wale hisse, dono dugne hue, aur rang utna hi raha. Ab bina mode, guna karke barabar fraction banayenge. Yahan tak saaf hai?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
sixer

Wah, sixer! Toh tumhara favourite yahi hai. Chalo, jahan the wahin se aage chalte hain. Is patti ke 5 barabar hisse hain aur 2 mein rang, yaani 2/5. Neeche ka 5 saare hisse ginta hai, aur upar ka 2 rang wale. Nayi patti utni hi lambi hai, par har hissa 2 chhote hisson mein kata hai. Pehli patti ke rang wale 2 hisse, nayi patti mein kitne chhote hisse bante hain?

director.text: 2 sahi nahi hai. Har hissa 2 mein kata, toh rang wala har hissa bhi 2 chhote hisse bana. Isliye rang wale hisse utne hi nahi rehte; woh bhi dugne hote hain. Pehli patti ke rang wale 2 hisse, nayi patti ke kitne chhote hisse bante hain?

director.text: chaar

Haan, bilkul theek: har rang wala hissa 2 bana, toh 4. Is patti mein rang 4/10 hai, aur yahi 2/5 bhi hai. Neeche 5 × 2 = 10 aur upar 2 × 2 = 4: dono ek hi number se guna hue. Ab 5/6 ke upar aur neeche, dono ko 2 se guna karo. Kaunsa barabar fraction banega?
director.card: Ab 5/6 ke upar aur neeche, dono ko 2 se guna karo. Kaunsa barabar fraction banega?

director.text: Nahi, 10/6 theek nahi. Ek aur raasta aazmaate hain. Patti ka har hissa 2 mein kaato, toh kul hisse bhi dugne hote hain aur rang wale hisse bhi. Isliye upar aur neeche, dono number 2 se guna hote hain, koi ek nahi. 1/6 ke barabar fraction mein neeche 12 likha hai. Upar ka number kitna hoga?
director.card: 1/6 ke barabar fraction mein neeche 12 likha hai. Upar ka number kitna hoga?

director.text: 1 se baat nahi bani. 12 hisson wali patti ka ek hissa, 6 hisson wali patti ke ek hisse se chhota hai. Isliye upar 1 hi rakhne se rang kam ho jaata hai. Neeche 12 ho, toh 1/6 ke barabar fraction ka upar wala number kya aayega?
director.card: 1/6 ke barabar fraction mein neeche 12 likha hai. Upar ka number kitna hoga?

director.text: 1 sahi nahi hai. Pehle dekho ki 1/6 ka neeche wala number kis number se guna hokar 12 banta hai. Phir upar wale ko bhi usi se guna karo. Ab tum batao.
director.card: 1/6 ke barabar fraction mein neeche 12 likha hai. Upar ka number kitna hoga?

director.text: upar 2

Sahi jawab, kyunki neeche 6 × 2 = 12, toh upar bhi 1 × 2 = 2, yaani 2/12. Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. Ab 5/6 ke upar aur neeche, dono ko 2 se guna karo. Kaunsa barabar fraction banega?
director.card: Ab 5/6 ke upar aur neeche, dono ko 2 se guna karo. Kaunsa barabar fraction banega?

seams.form: Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain.

director.text: 10 bata 12

Haan, bilkul theek. Hisse 6 se 12, toh rang wale 5 se 10. Kuch bachche 1/2 ke upar-neeche 1 jodkar 2/3 likhte hain; number line par 1/2 aur 2/3 alag jagah hain. Isi line par 1/3, 0 ke baad doosre mark par hai. 1/3 ke upar aur neeche 1 jodo, toh 2/4 banta hai. 2/4 is line par 0 ke baad kaunse mark par aayega?
director.card: Isi line par 1/3, 0 ke baad doosre mark par hai. 1/3 ke upar aur neeche 1 jodo, toh 2/4 banta hai. 2/4 is line par 0 ke baad kaunse mark par aayega?

director.text: Nahi, 2 theek nahi. Isko doosri tarah se samajhte hain. Upar-neeche ek hi number jodne se barabar fraction nahi banta. 4 hisson se 8 banane ke liye har hissa 2 mein kaata, toh rang wala 1 hissa bhi 2 bana: dono 2 se guna hue. 2/3 ke barabar ek fraction ka neeche 6 hai. Uska upar kya aayega?
director.card: 2/3 ke barabar ek fraction ka neeche 6 hai. Uska upar kya aayega?

seams.form: Isko doosri tarah se samajhte hain.

director.text: 5 se baat nahi bani. 5/6 mein sirf ek chhota hissa khaali hai, par 2/3 mein ek bada hissa khaali hai. Isliye upar 3 jodne se rang badh gaya. 2/3 ke barabar, neeche 6 wale fraction ka upar wala number kya aayega?
director.card: 2/3 ke barabar ek fraction ka neeche 6 hai. Uska upar kya aayega?

director.text: 5 sahi nahi hai. 2/3 ke hisson se 6 hisse banane ke liye har hissa kaise kaatna padega, aur tab rang wale hisson ka kya hoga, yeh socho. Apna jawab tum khud bolo.
director.card: 2/3 ke barabar ek fraction ka neeche 6 hai. Uska upar kya aayega?

director.text: upar 4

director.text: Haan, bilkul theek: 2/4 = 1/2 = 3/6, yaani 0 ke baad 3 gap; 1/3 sirf 2 gap par hai. Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum saath mein karte hain. Neha ko 3/5 ke barabar do fraction likhne hain: ek jiska neeche wala number 10 ho, aur ek jiska 15. Neeche 5 se 10 bana. Upar ke 3 ke saath kya karoge?
